units.source_text: 我看完这些报道后，日渐觉得生活在这个国家里也相当憋闷，于是想方设法想回到人间。

en.t: After reading these reports, I gradually came to feel that living in this country was quite stifling too, so I tried every possible way to return to the human world.

units.source_text: 但是无论如何努力，也找不到我当时掉进去的那个洞。

en.t: But no matter how hard I tried, I could not find the hole I had fallen into back then.

units.source_text: 后来我听那个打鱼的河童巴咯跟我说，河童国边界上有一只年迈的河童，他读书吹笛，自娱自乐，一个人安宁地过着日子。

en.t: Later, I heard from Baro, the fishing kappa, that on the border of Kappa Country there was an elderly kappa who read books, played the flute, amused himself, and lived peacefully all alone.

units.source_text: 我琢磨着或许能向他了解到逃离这个国家的途径，就立刻跑到边界上去。

en.t: Thinking that I might be able to learn from him a way to escape this country, I immediately ran to the border.

units.source_text: 过去一看，根本没什么老河童，在一座小房子里，只有一只刚满十二三岁、脑袋上的凹坑还没长硬的河童，悠闲的吹着笛子。

en.t: When I went there and looked, there was no old kappa at all; in a little house, there was only a kappa of barely twelve or thirteen, whose hollow on the head had not yet hardened, leisurely playing the flute.
I thought I must have come to the wrong door.

units.source_text: 为保险起见，我还是问问他的名字，果不其然他就是巴咯告诉我的那只老河童。

en.t: To make sure, I asked his name anyway, and sure enough, he was the old kappa Baro had told me about.
